points.description: Describes that the new (unlabelled) data point is compared with the stored, already labelled/classified training data, and the k nearest points (e.g. by distance, or within a neighbourhood/"sphere" around the new point) are selected. Equivalent wording, or pseudo code/steps doing this (compute distances, sort, take k smallest), earns the mark.

States that the class (label/colour) with the majority/maximum vote among the k nearest neighbours is found and the new data point is assigned to that class. Equivalent wording or pseudo code (count labels among neighbours, assign the most frequent) earns the mark.
